tooltip.mistvale_rpg.soul_shard: A splinter of a restless soul.
tooltip.mistvale_rpg.soul_shard.use: Use it on a Caged Soul Block. Three shards break the cage.
tooltip.mistvale_rpg.soul_crystal.use: Place it to float in the air. Put it in the crafting grid to make a Charged Soul Block again.
message.mistvale_rpg.caged_soul.needs_sh: The soul is caged. It stirs at the touch of a Soul Shard.
message.mistvale_rpg.caged_soul.freed: The cage breaks. The soul of %s is free.
message.mistvale_rpg.charged_soul.waitin: The soul of %s waits. Nine souls together, on the eight lanes around a centre, will open the way.
message.mistvale_rpg.soul_platform.no_ro: There is no room above the platform for a rift.
message.mistvale_rpg.soul_platform.fizzl: The power drains away. The platform is broken.
message.mistvale_rpg.rift.leads_nowhere: This rift does not lead anywhere yet, so it spits you out at the world spawn.
subtitles.mistvale_rpg.warp_arrive: Someone arrives in a burst of light
subtitles.mistvale_rpg.void_arrive: Someone claws out of the void
dialogue.mistvale_rpg.first_meeting.hell: Oh! Oh, you are awake! You really are awake. I was not sure the mist would let you go.
dialogue.mistvale_rpg.first_meeting.who_: I am the Spirit of Mistvale. Well, a spirit. Of Mistvale. The last one still glowing, anyway.
dialogue.mistvale_rpg.first_meeting.ask_: Ask me anything, %s. I like questions. They are like little lanterns.
dialogue.mistvale_rpg.first_meeting.wher: Mistvale. The vale under the mist. Pine, marsh, and old stones that remember things. It is beautiful, mostly. A little haunted. Mostly beautiful.
dialogue.mistvale_rpg.first_meeting.what: The Kraken took your ship. It took nearly everything. I found you on the beach with a note in your fist, and you slept for a very long time.
dialogue.mistvale_rpg.first_meeting.the_: The mist ate the ink, but I read it first. It said: bring the nine souls home. Whoever sent you into this has some explaining to do!
dialogue.mistvale_rpg.first_meeting.read: Then let us get you started! There are four ways into Mistvale from here, and each one is a different kind of beautiful.
dialogue.mistvale_rpg.first_meeting.whic: Four ways in. Which one is mine?
North, to the North Marr Lands
dialogue.mistvale_rpg.first_meeting.nort: The Marr Lands! Cold wind, old graves, and very good soup. Wear something warm.
dialogue.mistvale_rpg.first_meeting.west: The Wild West! Wide skies and wilder gardens. Do not feed anything that blooms.
dialogue.mistvale_rpg.first_meeting.sout: Sandy Shores! Sand, sun, and one or two things in the water. Mostly friendly.
dialogue.mistvale_rpg.first_meeting.east: The Morrows? Ooh. Ooh no. Well... yes. Fine. Bring a lantern. Bring two.
dialogue.mistvale_rpg.first_meeting.rift: Hold still, this will tickle. There! Touch the rift and it will carry you. It will not bite. Much.
dialogue.mistvale_rpg.again.hello: Hello again, %s! You came back to see me. That is the nicest thing.
dialogue.mistvale_rpg.again.mist: The mist is calm today. If it starts to whisper, you know where to find me.
dialogue.mistvale_rpg.welcome.hello_nort: There you are, %s! Welcome to the North Marr Lands. Mind the wind, and mind the graves. The graves are mostly polite.
dialogue.mistvale_rpg.welcome.hello_west: There you are, %s! Welcome to the Wild West. Wide skies, wild gardens. Please do not pet anything that blooms.
dialogue.mistvale_rpg.welcome.hello_sout: There you are, %s! Welcome to Sandy Shores. Warm sand, cool water, and a few things in the waves that are only a little hungry.
dialogue.mistvale_rpg.welcome.hello_east: There you are, %s! Welcome to the Morrows. It is... quiet here. Suspiciously quiet. Stay close to me.
dialogue.mistvale_rpg.welcome.settle: Look around, settle in, and find yourself a place to sleep. When you are ready, I will be right here.
